realDryRun.notes: Real BSC -> Hedera Testnet transfer through Inaya's own native bridge (not Wormhole -- Hedera runs the EVM directly via Hedera Smart Contract Service/Hashio JSON-RPC relay, so the SAME InayaTokenBridgeSpoke/InayaMessenger Solidity bytecode already proven on Sepolia/Fuji/Arbitrum was deployed unchanged, no new contract language needed). One real, Hedera-specific quirk found along the way: an EVM account that has never received any value does not exist on Hedera's ledger yet -- a transaction FROM that account fails with 'Sender account not found' until it first receives an inbound transfer (Hedera auto-creates the account on that first credit). The relayer wallet hit this; fixed by sending it a small HBAR transfer from the funded deployer wallet first. Also: Hedera's gas cost for that very first inbound transfer to a not-yet-existing account is materially higher than a normal transfer (~660k gas vs the usual ~21k) since it's paying for real account creation, not just a value move -- budget for that when funding a fresh Hedera wallet for the first time.
